title: Fal doubles valuation to $16B amid AI inference demand surge
digest:
Fal increased its valuation from $8B to $16B through a $1.3B funding round, with TechCrunch attributing this to surging demand for AI inference services. The round was led by existing investors including Sequoia and Accel, with new participation from软银愿景基金.

The startup, founded by former Coinbase and Oracle employees, now claims to serve over 100 enterprise clients. However, TechCrunch noted that its margins remain compressed due to high computational costs, contrasting with the $1.2B valuation of peer Baseten which also saw funding growth. The funding was announced on November 4, 2026.
